name: Application launcher
description: Opens whichever launcher is configured: Kickoff, KRunner, the built-in one, or a command of your own.

glyph.label: Glyph
glyph.description: A Material Symbols name, drawn on the accent tile. Empty draws the theme icon below instead.

icon.label: Theme icon
icon.description: Drawn when the glyph is empty, or where Material Symbols is not installed.

label.label: Label
label.description: Shown beside the icon. Empty for icon only.
